sentences.text:
Measuring half a millimeter long,
*Tardigrades* are Earth's most indestructible animals.
sentences.spoken: Measuring less than half a millimeter long, tardigrades, or water bears, are the most indestructible animals on planet Earth.

sentences.text:
They survived *all five mass extinction events*
over 600 million years of Earth history.
sentences.spoken: These microscopic eight-legged metazoans have survived all five mass extinction events over the past six hundred million years.

sentences.text:
In deadly conditions, they enter *cryptobiosis*,
expelling 99% of their body water.
sentences.spoken: When environmental conditions turn hostile, they enter cryptobiosis, expelling ninety-nine percent of the water from their bodies.

sentences.text:
In this 'tun' state, their metabolism slows,
*virtually stopping biological time*.
sentences.spoken: In this dehydrated tun state, their metabolism slows to less than zero point zero one percent of normal, virtually stopping biological time.

sentences.text:
Proteins turn their cellular interior into
*protective biological glass* in stasis.
sentences.spoken: Special disordered proteins transform their cellular interior into a protective biological glass, locking vital organs in stasis.

sentences.text:
They survive *-272°C absolute zero*,
150°C boiling heat, and the vacuum of space.
sentences.spoken: Tardigrades have survived temperatures of minus two hundred and seventy-two degrees Celsius, boiling water at one hundred and fifty degrees, and the vacuum of open space.

sentences.text:
They survive *1,000x human lethal radiation*,
rapidly repairing their shattered DNA.
sentences.spoken: They withstand one thousand times more ionizing radiation than a human, repairing their shattered DNA with unique suppressor proteins.

sentences.text:
A protein called *Dsup* wraps around their DNA
like a bulletproof armor shield.
sentences.spoken: A unique protein called Dsup binds to their chromatin like a molecular armor shield, deflecting hydroxyl free radicals.

sentences.text:
Add a single drop of water after 30 years,
*and they rehydrate and walk away unharmed*.
sentences.spoken: Add a single drop of water after thirty years of frozen sleep, and the water bear rehydrates, stands up, and walks away unharmed.
